title: AI as a Coding Assistant (No Experience Needed)
description: Use AI to automate a simple data task — even if you have never written code — by letting AI write and explain the code for you.
steps: Choose a data task you currently do manually: cleaning a spreadsheet, counting occurrences, formatting a list
Prompt: "Write Python code that [task]. I am not a developer — explain each line in simple terms."
In ChatGPT with Code Interpreter: upload a sample file and ask it to run the code
If there is an error, paste the error back and ask: "This error occurred. Fix it and explain what went wrong"
Reflect: what took longer, understanding the code or doing the task manually?
expectedOutput: A working code snippet that automates one data task, with your own annotations explaining what it does.
bonusChallenges: Ask AI to turn the code into a function you could reuse
Have AI review its own code for edge cases or errors
